The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 19/05/2021 and at the time of marriage accused persons demanded and taken a gold chain, gold ring to accused No.1 and have taken gold ornaments from CW4 and 5 on the guise of gift to CW1 as dowry.

Accused persons have subjected CW1 to physical and mental cruelty by quarreling with CW1,

After completion of the investigation, the Pplice Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed charge sheet against accused persons for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this Court took cognizance of the alleged offences.

sentences.text: 6. Heard the arguments advanced by the counsel for accused.
The counsel for complainant submitted written arguments reiterating the facts and circumstances of the case and prays for convicting the accused persons in accordance with law.
In support of the defence.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all  reasonable doubt that accused No.1 to 4  have subjected CW1 to mental and physical  cruelty in respect of demand of dowry and  thereby accused have committed the offences  punishable U/s.498A, 504 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
 & Sec.4 of D.P. Act ?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the NEGATIVE  Point No.2........ As per final order,
 for the following:
 6  C.C.No.403/2023  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined five witness as PW1 got marked Ex.P1 to Ex.P2 documents.

10. CW1 was examined as PW1 Smt. Komala deposed that accused No.1 had married her on 19/05/2021 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not abused and threatened her and accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2(a) and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1  7  C.C.No.403/2023 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence Komala R vs Punith V on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138866450/
5 was taken as closed.
